developmental_stage.evidence: inferred: Nephronophthisis is one of the leading genetic causes of end-stage renal disease in childhood.

sample_source.evidence: inferred: Urine samples (40 to 400 ml) were collected from all subjects using sterile urine containers and kept on ice for a maximum of five hours until processing.

sex.evidence: Supernatants were processed in three batches of eight subjects with equal numbers of patients and controls, male and female subjects and uniform mean subject age to preclude batch effects.

tissue.evidence: inferred: We aimed to identify non-invasive protein biomarkers for nephronophthisis in urinary extracellular vesicles.
